source: six already retained Prometheus text files only
limits: Cumulative cuts are not a per-request timeline; file mtimes are retention metadata, not instant sampling timestamps.
Authority service mixes read and mutation operations; totals do not distinguish those operations.
Handler and client latencies are sampled one in32; absence of slow sampled handler does not bound all handler durations.
The first/terminal gauges do not measure peak/intermediate occupancy.
Service task result ok is transport-handler success; typed application rejection encoded in a successful reply remains ok.
Response callback ignores Send enqueue error; no dedicated response-Send-result metric or retained request correlation exists.
No other labels, raw metrics, UIDs, payloads or runtime error text are copied.
